resources.string: Approved contacts are not enforced right now (not locked, or maintenance unlock).
Make Plainphone the phone and SMS app, so calls and messages are limited to approved contacts.
No approved contacts yet. A parent can add them on the maintenance screen.
Only these people can call and text this phone. Emergency numbers such as 112 always work. Apps like WhatsApp and Signal are not covered by this list.
Messages from people who are not approved are not shown. Picture and group messages (MMS) are not supported yet.

Scan this code with the camera on the parent\'s phone. Or open app.plainphone.org, choose Add phone, then Type the code.
Waiting for the parent… The code is valid for 15 minutes.
Paired. The parent\'s rules now apply.

This list is managed in the parent\'s dashboard (app.plainphone.org). Change it there.
Closes apps your parent has not allowed, and apps whose time is up.

Plainphone uses this to see which app is open, so it can close apps that are not allowed or whose time is used up, and to keep its own protection from being switched off. It reads nothing else and sends nothing about what you do, apart from minutes used for apps with a time limit.
Plainphone uses this so it has to be switched off here before it can be uninstalled.
With this on, Plainphone cannot simply be uninstalled. The parent is told if it is switched off.
Switching this off removes Plainphone\'s protection. The parent will be told.
You need it to change Plainphone on this phone later. At least 6 digits. Keep it to yourself.
The two PINs are not the same.
Then only approved contacts can call, and calls go only to them. Emergency numbers always work.
Text messages to and from numbers that are not approved are stopped.
Android calls it a VPN. It only looks up web addresses through the Plainphone filter. No other traffic goes through it.
Needed for time limits. Find Plainphone in the list and switch it on.
With this on, Plainphone cannot simply be removed. The parent is told if it is switched off.
Allow notifications, and let Plainphone run without battery limits, so Android does not stop it.
Lets the parent see where the phone is when they press Find. Choose \"Allow all the time\". Only the last position is kept.

In the list, open Plainphone guard and switch it on. It closes apps that are not allowed. If Android says the setting is restricted: open App info for Plainphone, tap the three dots and choose Allow restricted settings.
Tap the gear next to Plainphone and switch on Always-on VPN. Leave \"Block connections without VPN\" off: Plainphone\'s filter only carries web addresses.
On the parent\'s phone, open app.plainphone.org and scan the code Plainphone shows next.
Plainphone now follows the parent\'s rules. Rules change from the parent\'s dashboard.
This app is not on your list
Ask your parent if you need it. They can allow it in Plainphone.
It opens again tomorrow. Calls and messages work as always.
Plainphone\'s protection can only be changed with the parent\'s PIN.
Some of the protection is switched off.
This switches off the guard, the web filter and device admin, so Plainphone can be uninstalled. The parent is told. Continue?
Version %1$s is ready. Tap to open the download.
